segments.sn24.18:1.2: “Kismiṃ nu kho, bhikkhave, sati, kiṃ upādāya, kiṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati –
segments.sn24.18:1.3: ‘neva hoti, na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’”ti?
segments.sn24.18:1.4: Bhagavaṃmūlakā no, bhante, dhammā … pe …“rūpe kho, bhikkhave, sati, rūpaṃ upādāya, rūpaṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati –
segments.sn24.18:2.2: ‘neva hoti, na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ti … pe ….
segments.sn24.18:3.1: “Taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, rūpaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn24.18:3.3: “Aniccaṃ, bhante”… pe … vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, api nu taṃ anupādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya –
segments.sn24.18:3.5: ‘neva hoti, na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā”ti?
segments.sn24.18:3.7: “Yampidaṃ diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ mutaṃ viññātaṃ pattaṃ pariyesitaṃ anuvicaritaṃ manasā tampi niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn24.18:3.9: “Yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn24.18:3.11: “Yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, api nu taṃ anupādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya –
segments.sn24.18:3.12: ‘neva hoti, na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’”ti?
segments.sn24.18:4.1: “Yato kho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvakassa imesu ca ṭhānesu kaṅkhā pahīnā hoti, dukkhepissa kaṅkhā pahīnā hoti, dukkhasamudayepissa kaṅkhā pahīnā hoti, dukkhanirodhepissa kaṅkhā pahīnā hoti, dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāyapissa kaṅkhā pahīnā hoti – ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako sotāpanno avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano”ti.
segments.sn24.18:5.1: Vātaṃ etaṃ mama, so attā no ca me siyā;
segments.sn24.18:5.3: Natthi karoto hetu ca, mahādiṭṭhena aṭṭhamaṃ.
segments.sn24.18:6.1: Sassato loko ca, asassato ca antavā ca;
segments.sn24.18:6.3: Anantavā ca taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīranti;
segments.sn24.18:7.3: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti.
